predecessors.name: Qin dynasty
predecessors.text: northern Henan and southern Hebei, the Henei region, given to the Zhao general Sima Ang in 206 BC

successors.name: Kingdom of Han (Liu Bang)
successors.text: 'The former Kingdom of Yin became the Henei Commandery of the Han Empire' (Sima Ang page)

ledger.x: 206: Xiang Yu makes Sima Ang King of Yin.
205: Sima Ang is captured and surrenders.
205: the Kingdom of Yin passes to the Han.
205: the Kingdom of Yin ends as Henei Commandery; Sima Ang died within a month at Pengcheng.

wars.name: Han conquest of Henei (Kingdom of Yin)
wars.outcome: Liu Bang and Han Xin, helped by Wei Bao of Western Wei, took Henei in April-May 205; Sima Ang surrendered and the kingdom became Henei Commandery.

certainty.note: The pages give 'northern Henan, southern Hebei' and a capital, never a boundary.
